about_the_game:
What exactly is Vault of the Vanquished?

Vault of the Vanquished is a roguelike adventure where you collect hundreds of cards, passive items, and coins to become the ultimate treasure hunter. Strategize, adapt, and grow stronger with every run!

This game is built on the idea of RNG, brining you through countless completely randomized encounters to 100s of items you can unveil to use in your run! Push to Vanquish enough enemies to fight the boss of the stage. Play from 4 different characters that have different skills and items to keep gameplay fresh!

Everything in the game now!

  • 50 100 Items!

  • 2 Playable Characters! (Ranger, Bruiser)

  • 2 Complete Stages!

Here's What's Coming to the Game

  • Plague Doctor (Character)

  • Medic (Character)

  • Custom Item Creation!

  • Custom Arena Creation!

  • Custom Enemy Creation!

  • Steam Workshop!

content_descriptors.notes: This game just depicts occasional themes like suicide, abuse and drugs when it comes to the name of some items, but nothing is acted on in-game.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 1650 GTX 4GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: NVIDIA High Definition Audio
  • Additional Notes: Might run on lower spec hardwear, this is just what I had to test Minimum System Requirements.
